acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Doppelgangers family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Halfling Copy, T2, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Unfinished-Side Soldier (Soldier) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Half-copied form with one unformed gray arm and a nearly right face blurred at the mouth.
Signature mechanic: Half-Learned Cut: the finished side copies a simple cut as the unformed gray arm attempts and fails to mirror it.
battlefieldDuty: Repeat copied weapon pressure from a partial disguise whose one gray arm cannot complete the same motion.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 blank smooth flesh and one featureless limb gain an external mineral boundary clamp without marking the body; T2 the partial copy and unfinished arm gain a sediment copied-surface edge; T3 the jaw seam and wrong hand gain crystal load keys; T4 layered faces and mask edges gain mineral clasps; T5 body-wide faces and mask crown gain bounded fracture latches.

Motion/process branches: T1 the blank featureless limb briefly loads its external silhouette clamp; T2 the partial copy transfers weight away from the unfinished arm; T3 the wrong hand loads the jaw-seam key; T4 layered faces rotate one mask-clasp load; T5 body-wide faces load and release one mask-crown latch.
counterplay: Cross the unfinished-arm side and punish its smooth shoulder after the copied cut. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the blank smooth-flesh featureless limb exposes its external silhouette-clamp fault after load; T2 the partial copy exposes a fracture at the unfinished arm; T3 the jaw seam and wrong hand expose the active load key after correction; T4 layered faces expose the mask-clasp fault after rotation; T5 body-wide faces expose the mask-crown fracture latch after load, preserving copy readability.
forbiddenTreatments: Mineral mass that hides the copied identity
identityInvariants: A generic humanoid copy silhouette retains one deliberate flaw until layered face and mask motifs appear at explicit upper tiers.
Clay-gray skin, putty, borrowed colors, porcelain, copied cloth, and smooth flesh remain discrete source materials rather than Earth affinity.
Seams, wrong joints, ill-fitting clothes, and layered masks reveal copy quality while preserving the readable original-copy relationship.
Disguise fidelity escalates from an entirely blank true form to a sovereign carrying many stolen-looking faces at once.
telegraph: The nearly right face blurs at the mouth and borrowed color drains toward the finished shoulder.
